# Musaev Marketing

> Digital marketing agency in Fergana, Uzbekistan, founded on 11 November 2023 by Elbek Musaev (nine years in marketing). Slogan: "Kontentdan natijaga" (From content to results). Serves the Fergana Valley: Fergana, Margilan, Kokand, Kuvasay, Namangan, Andijan.

- Services: marketing strategy, content and video production (Reels, Stories), Instagram/Facebook ads; new: sales-team scripts and inquiry tracking; AI-assisted content operations.
- Main experience: residential real estate developers in the Fergana Valley; also retail, restaurants, automotive service, education.
- Phone: +998 91 999-33-31. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/musaev_marketing/
